items.title: Exact polychromatic parameter of unions of s axis-parallel strips in the plane
items.author: Balázs Bursics; Bence Csonka; Luca Szepessy
items.difficulty_reason: The counted object is an exact identity between two family parameters, m_{A_s}(k) = s*m_A(k)-s+1, where A_s is the family of unions of s axis-parallel strips (source lines 237-238) and m_A(k) is left as a black box, so both directions have to be derived from the definition of the two families rather than computed. The lower-bound direction at source line 680 needs a concrete realisation step that the statement alone does not suggest: k(s-1)+1 translated copies of one extremal member are placed along a diagonal so that every captured subset of the original set survives in the copy, and then two counting steps are chained, one pigeonhole over the copies to obtain s copies sharing a missing colour and one geometric reading of the s bad edges as a single edge of A_s of size s*m_A(k)-s. The reverse direction at source line 682 is short but easy to get wrong: an edge of the s-strip family must be split into its s strips, and only then does the pigeonhole give m_A(k) points inside one strip where all k colours are known to occur. Quoting the definition of m_A(k) without the diagonal copy construction and without the s-strip split yields neither inequality.
